in_marathi.name: Parmanand
in_marathi.long_meaning: Parmanand हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Parmanand is a Sanskrit name derived from the words Param (supreme) and Anand (bliss). It is a name that signifies the ultimate attainment of happiness and joy, often associated with spiritual enlightenment and liberation from worldly desires.
